result.topic_en: Heat conduction in an ellipsoid: the Laplacian is transformed into confocal ellipsoidal coordinates, the problem is reduced by separation of variables to an ordinary (Lamé-type) differential equation, and an asymptotic series solution for large parameter g is computed.

methods.what: Confocal ellipsoidal coordinates defined by roots of f
Derivative of f expressed through the coordinates
Heat equation in ellipsoidal coordinates and separation with exponential time factor
Change of variable to elliptic integral e, normal form
Riccati substitution w=exp(∫v) and asymptotic series in g (WKB-type)
Recursion for coefficients of the asymptotic series
Asymptotic expansion of the phase integral
